notes.title: Update Notes for Mar 05
notes.content:
Hi friends!
Just some minnor bug fixes about player and some enemies.
As always, thanks for all your suport!

notes.title: Update Notes for Feb 19
notes.content:
Hi friends!
Here´s some fixes and a special movement!
https://i.postimg.cc/yxyTb5dm/dash.gif
Now, if you try to move while blocking, you can dash from side to side!

This makes it easier to escape enemy attacks!

Thanks for all the support you've given!

notes.title: Update notes for Feb 13, 2022
notes.content:
Hi friends!

So, now is possible to play with controllers. The keyboad one is still active.
I believe it will bring better gameplay and more fun!

And so, there are some fixes for some bugs found by you in the game.
Thank you very much for your support!

notes.title: Update notes for February 02
notes.content:
https://i.ibb.co/SNxy4nF/block.gif

It is now possible to block attacks by pressing the "i" key  and we can resist for a few hits before losing energy, while we are blocking!
 While the controls configuration is not ready, we can use "j" to punch, "k" to kick and "L" to jump.
 Fixed some issues related to achievements.
 Improved player performance/speed.


So, for the next updates, I'll be working mainly on the issue of a better configuration for the controls.

notes.title: Update notes for January 31
notes.content:
Some bug fixes implemented.


Game balance: Enemies are not as strong as they were before
Some fixes about the player attacks
Fixes on musics


And so, I´m currently working to implement some new details and create a better control system.
